card.name: Scattered sentence-continuation points in web text
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on varied connectors and sentence starts such as 'Now', 'and', 'the' and a period in general educational or web prose.

modes.label: Sentence-opening Now
modes.description: The word Now begins a new step in a physics explanation.
modes.example: This is Newton's law of inertia. <<Now>> suppose that the gravity switch is turned on

modes.label: And joining clauses
modes.description: The word 'and' links a topic to a further activity in a lesson summary.
modes.example: students research the events that led to Columbus finding America<< and>> participate in a jeopardy game regarding his adventure

card.plain: It reacts to assorted small linking words in ordinary web text, with no pattern a clinician could use.
